material_units.source_text: Triangle inequality for $\ell_2$ from Cauchy–Schwarz: $\|x+y\|^2=\|x\|^2+2x^\top y+\|y\|^2\le(\|x\|+\|y\|)^2$. The reverse triangle inequality $\big|\,\|x\|-\|y\|\,\big|\le\|x-y\|$ follows from $\|x\|\le\|x-y\|+\|y\|$ and symmetry: every norm is 1-Lipschitz. Stacked vectors $z=(x,u)$: $\|z\|_2^2=\|x\|_2^2+\|u\|_2^2$, $\|z\|_1=\|x\|_1+\|u\|_1$, $\|z\|_\infty=\max\{\|x\|_\infty,\|u\|_\infty\}$. A punctured ball $\{u:0\lt\|u\|_2\le1\}$ excludes the centre, where $u/\|u\|_2$ is undefined.
